Synopsis:
Short-term meteorological outlook covering three regions: (1) Typhoon Jangmi approaching Okinawa with sustained winds ~67mph and deepening pressure; (2) a 980hPa low sweeping southeast Australia threatening Victoria with severe gusts; (3) anomalous heat persisting over southern Iberia, with temperatures 5–10°C above long-term averages reaching up to 40°C.

Risk score: 20 — Early-June Iberian heat and Western Pacific typhoon activity are broadly seasonal and not structurally surprising. The 5–10°C above-average anomaly adds some incremental signal, but no materially unexpected information for energy markets.
